description: [Personal research only] Fetch MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) technical indicator time series with signal line and histogram.

end_date.description: Optional end date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2024-12-31').

fastperiod.description: Fast EMA period for MACD calculation (default: 12)

max_data_points.description: Maximum number of time series data points to return.

series_type.description: Price data to use for calculation.

signalperiod.description: Signal line EMA period for MACD calculation (default: 9)

slowperiod.description: Slow EMA period for MACD calculation (default: 26)

start_date.description: Optional start date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2024-01-01').

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., 'AAPL', 'MSFT', 'TSLA') for which to calculate MACD

name: fetch_macd
